title: AI Engine
description: ChatGPT Powered Professional AI Plugin. Takes 4 years to Build.
body:
# IMPORTANT **Put Your API Key Of Open-AI In the `config.yml` {If You Don't Know How to Get Follow these Steps**- ``` 1 - Go to [Click Me to get API Key](https://platform.openai.com/login) 2 - Create A Account or Login If you already have. 3 - After Creating Account Or Registering Click on Generate API Key. 4 - Copy Your API Key and Go to the congig.yml of the plugin. 5 - Paste Your API Key Inside the inverted Commas • api-key: "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE". ``` ![Divider](https://i.imgur.com/waxVImv.png) ![AI Engine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f56f367fa1fe65309d0f47635064209cbddd56b0_0.webp) #
**SUPPORT ME ON KO-FI FOR FUTURE UPDATES...** [![Support on Ko-fi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42842d1ee202e01625163e03f9b5364a0ac07ce2.gif)](https://ko-fi.com/prabhatpie) # 🤖 **AI ENGINE** *Minecraft worlds that truly think.* ![Divider](https://i.imgur.com/waxVImv.png) **An Advanced AI-Powered Minecraft Plugin** Created by **PrabhatPie** > Transform your Minecraft server into a living intelligent world > with smart AI NPCs, dynamic quests, immersive storytelling, > survival assistance, moderation systems, and real AI conversations.
--- # 📌 OVERVIEW > **AI Engine** is a next-generation Minecraft AI ecosystem that brings intelligent NPCs and advanced AI systems directly into your server. Unlike normal chat plugins, AI Engine creates: - 🧠 Smart AI personalities - 🏰 Dynamic world interactions - 📖 AI-generated stories - ⚔️ Intelligent quests - 🛡️ AI moderation - 🧱 Build assistance - 🌍 Living immersive gameplay --- # ✨ FEATURES | Feature | Description | |---|---| | 🤖 AI Chat | Talk naturally with intelligent AI NPCs | | 🧠 Personality System | Unique NPC personalities & behaviors | | 📜 Dynamic Quests | AI-generated quests based on player progression | | 🏰 Build Assistant | Get build ideas, palettes, and structure plans | | ⚔️ Survival Assistant | Receive survival tips and combat help | | 🛡️ AI Moderation | Detect spam, toxicity, griefing & suspicious behavior | | 📖 Storytelling Engine | Dynamic lore and immersive world stories | | 🛒 AI Shopkeepers | Interactive merchants with intelligent dialogue | | 🎓 Tutorial Helper | Guides new players through Minecraft mechanics | | 💾 Smart Memory | AI remembers conversations and players | | 🌦️ Context Awareness | AI understands biome, weather, mobs & surroundings | | 🌐 Multiplayer Ready | Supports advanced multiplayer interactions | --- # 🧠 AI PERSONALITIES | Personality | Behavior | |---|---| | 🧙 Wise Wizard | Ancient knowledge & magical lore | | 👑 Royal Merchant | Trading and economy expert | | 😂 Funny Goblin | Chaotic humorous interactions | | ⚔️ Mercenary | Combat and PvP specialist | | 🏹 Kingdom Guard | Security and protection | | 📚 Storyteller | Dynamic lore generation | | 🌲 Survival Expert | Hardcore survival assistance | | 🧑 Villager | Friendly immersive conversations | --- # ⚡ ADVANCED SYSTEMS ## 🔹 Intelligent Memory System AI remembers: - Player names - Previous conversations - Reputation - Trades - Quests - Kingdom relations --- ## 🔹 Dynamic Quest Generation AI creates: - Village defense missions - Dungeon exploration - Treasure hunts - Resource collection - Boss encounters - Kingdom wars --- ## 🔹 AI Build Assistant Get: - Material palettes - Layer-by-layer guides - Structure layouts - Decoration suggestions - Redstone help - Lighting recommendations --- ## 🔹 Smart Moderation Automatically detects: - Spam - Toxicity - Hack discussions - Griefing - Suspicious activity --- # 🖥️ TECH STACK | System | Technology | |---|---| | Language | Java 21 | | Platform | PaperMC / Spigot | | Database | MySQL 8 | | Cache | Redis | | AI Provider | OpenAI | | Networking | REST API + WebSockets | | Build Tool | Gradle | | Compatibility | 1.21+ | --- # 📂 PLUGIN STRUCTURE ```text AIEngine/ ├── ai/ ├── npc/ ├── moderation/ ├── quests/ ├── tutorials/ ├── story/ ├── builds/ ├── memory/ ├── database/ ├── websocket/ ├── api/ └── utils/ ``` --- # 🚀 PERFORMANCE ✅ Async AI Requests ✅ Redis Caching ✅ Optimized NPC Loading ✅ Smart Cooldowns ✅ Queue Systems ✅ Low-Lag Architecture ✅ Multiplayer Scalable --- # 🔒 SECURITY | Security Feature | Included | |---|---| | API Protection | ✅ | | Async Processing | ✅ | | Permission System | ✅ | | Input Validation | ✅ | | Cooldowns | ✅ | | Rate Limiting | ✅ | | Secure Configs | ✅ | --- # 📦 REQUIREMENTS | Requirement | Version | |---|---| | Java | 21+ | | Server Software | Paper / Spigot | | Minecraft Version | 1.21+ | | OpenAI API Key | Required | | MySQL | Recommended | | Redis | Optional | --- # 🎮 COMMANDS | Command | Description | |---|---| | `/ai` | Main AI command | | `/npc` | NPC management | | `/quest` | Quest management | --- # 🔥 EXAMPLE INTERACTION ### 👤 Player ```text I keep dying in caves. ``` ### 🤖 AI Engine ```text Your armor is underpowered for deep cave exploration. Bring: - Shield - Water bucket - Extra torches - Cooked food - Building blocks I also detected lava sounds east of your current position. ``` --- # 🌍 FUTURE PLANS - 🎤 Voice AI Integration - 🏰 AI Kingdom Systems - 🌌 AI World Events - 🧠 Vector Memory - 🤝 NPC-to-NPC Conversations - ⚡ Cross-Server AI Networks - 🛡️ Advanced Anti-Cheat AI - 🧱 AI Structure Generation --- # ❤️ WHY AI ENGINE? > AI Engine is designed to make Minecraft feel alive. Instead of static NPCs and repetitive gameplay, your world becomes intelligent, reactive, immersive, and unforgettable. --- **📥 INSTALLATION {IMPORTANT READ 5th Step}** ```text 1. Download AI Engine 2. Place into plugins folder 3. Start server 4. Configure config.yml 5. Add your OpenAI API Key 6. Restart server 7. Enjoy intelligent Minecraft gameplay ``` --- # 👨‍💻 AUTHOR ## **PrabhatPie** ### 🌟 *Creating next-generation Minecraft experiences.* --- #
